name: MiPlaits
description: Macro oscillator port of the Mutable Instruments Plaits eurorack module. Offers 24 synthesis engines covering virtual analog, FM, granular, additive, wavetable, physical modelling, percussion, speech, swarm, wave terrain and chiptune.

inputs.name: engine
inputs.description: Synthesis engine (0..23): virtual_analog, waveshaping, fm, grain, additive, wavetable, chord, speech, swarm, noise, particle, string, modal, bass_drum, snare_drum, hi_hat, virtual_analog_vcf, phase_distortion, 6op_bank1, 6op_bank2, 6op_bank3, wave_terrain, string_machine, chiptune

inputs.name: trigger
inputs.description: Non-zero value fires the internal envelope and excites physical/percussive models

inputs.name: level
inputs.description: Opens the internal low-pass gate, controlling amplitude and brightness

inputs.name: fm_mod
inputs.description: FM modulation amount when internal env is active (-1..1)

inputs.name: timb_mod
inputs.description: Timbre modulation amount when internal env is active (-1..1)

inputs.name: morph_mod
inputs.description: Morph modulation amount when internal env is active (-1..1)

inputs.name: decay
inputs.description: Decay rate of internal lowpass gate (0..1)

name: MiBraids
description: Macro oscillator port of the Mutable Instruments Braids eurorack module. 48 synthesis models covering classic waveforms, FM, physical modelling, percussion, wavetables, vocal/formant, granular and noise.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Synthesis model (0..47): CSAW, MORPH, SAW_SQUARE, SINE_TRIANGLE, BUZZ, SQUARE_SUB, SAW_SUB, SQUARE_SYNC, SAW_SYNC, TRIPLE_SAW, TRIPLE_SQUARE, TRIPLE_TRIANGLE, TRIPLE_SINE, TRIPLE_RING_MOD, SAW_SWARM, SAW_COMB, TOY, DIGITAL_FILTER_LP/PK/BP/HP, VOSIM, VOWEL, VOWEL_FOF, HARMONICS, FM, FEEDBACK_FM, CHAOTIC_FEEDBACK_FM, PLUCKED, BOWED, BLOWN, FLUTED, STRUCK_BELL, STRUCK_DRUM, KICK, CYMBAL, SNARE, WAVETABLES, WAVE_MAP, WAVE_LINE, WAVE_PARAPHONIC, FILTERED_NOISE, TWIN_PEAKS_NOISE, CLOCKED_NOISE, GRANULAR_CLOUD, PARTICLE_NOISE, DIGITAL_MODULATION, QUESTION_MARK

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger - non-positive to positive transition excites physical models or resets oscillator phase

inputs.name: resamp
inputs.description: Resample mode set at instantiation (0..2): 0=no resample, 1=internal 96kHz with downsample, 2=sample-rate decimation and bit reduction

inputs.name: decim
inputs.description: Sample-rate decimation factor (1..32). Only active when resamp=2

inputs.name: bits
inputs.description: Bit reduction (0..6): 0=16bit, 1=12, 2=8, 3=5, 4=4, 5=3, 6=2bit. Only active when resamp=2

inputs.name: ws
inputs.description: Waveshaping distortion amount (0..1). Only active when resamp=2

name: MiRings
description: Modal/sympathetic-string resonator port of the Mutable Instruments Rings eurorack module. Six resonator models including modal, sympathetic strings, inharmonic string, 2-op FM voice, quantized strings and string+reverb. Excite via audio input, trigger or non-stationary pitch.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Audio input used as excitation signal (0 to use the internal exciter)

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger to start a new note (non-positive to positive transition)

inputs.name: struct
inputs.description: Inharmonicity / interval structure (0..1) - depends on the model

inputs.name: bright
inputs.description: Brightness and richness of the spectrum (0..1)

inputs.name: pos
inputs.description: Position where the structure is excited (0..1)

inputs.name: poly
inputs.description: Polyphony, simultaneous voices (1..4). More voices = fewer partials per voice

inputs.name: intern_exciter
inputs.description: Force the internal exciter on even when an audio-rate excitation signal is patched (0/1)

inputs.name: easteregg
inputs.description: Toggle 'disastrous peace' easter-egg mode where 'model' selects an FX (0/1)

inputs.name: bypass
inputs.description: Bypass the resonator and pass the excitation input directly to the outputs (0/1)

name: MiElements
description: Modal physical-modelling exciter/resonator port of the Mutable Instruments Elements eurorack module. Combines BOW, BLOW and STRIKE exciters with a tunable resonator (modal, string, strings).

inputs.name: blow_in
inputs.description: External audio input diffused, amplified by the envelope and STRENGTH, sent to the resonator

inputs.name: strike_in
inputs.description: External audio input sent directly to the resonator (bypasses exciter)

inputs.name: gate
inputs.description: Gate triggering the exciter and its envelope. Open for positive values

inputs.name: contour
inputs.description: Bow/Blow envelope contour, interpolating between AD, ADSR and AR shapes

inputs.name: bow_level
inputs.description: Amplitude of bowing/scratching noise sent to the resonator (0..1)

inputs.name: blow_level
inputs.description: Amount of granular blowing noise sent to the resonator (0..1)

inputs.name: strike_level
inputs.description: Amount of percussive noise sent to the resonator (0..1)

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Air flow of the BLOW generator - scans through colours of noise (0..1)

inputs.name: mallet
inputs.description: Mallet type controlling percussive STRIKE generator timbre (0..1)

inputs.name: blow_timb
inputs.description: Pitch/granulation rate of the BLOW noise generator (0..1)

inputs.name: geom
inputs.description: Geometry/stiffness of the resonating structure: plates, strings, bars, bells (0..1)

inputs.name: damp
inputs.description: High frequency damping of the resonator (0..1)

inputs.name: pos
inputs.description: Position where the structure is excited (0..1)

inputs.name: space
inputs.description: Stereo width and amount of reverb (0..1)

name: MiClouds
description: Granular audio processor and texture synthesizer port of the Mutable Instruments Clouds eurorack module. Four playback modes: granular, stretch, looping delay and spectral.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Audio input. Mono is internally copied to the second channel

inputs.name: pos
inputs.description: Playback position in the internal buffer (0..1)

inputs.name: freeze
inputs.description: Freeze the buffer; non-zero pauses recording and locks playback (0/1)

inputs.name: lofi
inputs.description: Lofi mode (4-second buffer). Erases the buffer (0/1)

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger input for single grains (non-positive to positive transition)

name: MiTides
description: Function generator and quad LFO port of the Mutable Instruments Tides eurorack module. Looping AD envelope with shape, slope and smoothness controls; outputs gates, amplitudes, phases or frequencies on four channels.

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Frequency in Hz in looping mode, otherwise attack/release time

inputs.name: slope
inputs.description: Waveform slope from falling ramp to rising ramp (0..1)

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger or gate input. Resets envelope or oscillator phase

inputs.name: ratio
inputs.description: Clock ratio index (0..18). 9=1:1; lower indices divide, higher multiply

name: MiWarps
description: Meta-modulator port of the Mutable Instruments Warps eurorack module. Blends and combines two audio signals via cross-modulation, waveshaping or vocoding, with an internal oscillator and frequency-shifter easter-egg mode.

inputs.name: timb
inputs.description: Timbre - intensity of high harmonics from cross-modulation (0..1)

inputs.name: vgain
inputs.description: Vocoder output gain before final limiter (1..10)

name: MiVerb
description: Stereo reverb derived from Mutable Instruments' Clouds module, based on Jon Dattorro's Griesinger-topology paper. Useful for plate-like ambient tails with adjustable diffusion and freeze.

inputs.name: time
inputs.description: Reverb time (0..1.25). Values >=1 cause the tail to grow into soft saturation

inputs.name: freeze
inputs.description: Freeze the reverb tail and close the input (0/1)

name: MiRipples
description: Classic resonant 4-pole low-pass filter port of the Mutable Instruments Ripples eurorack module. Virtual-analog model from Alright Devices' VCV Rack adaptation - big, fat sound with self-oscillation.

name: MiGrids
description: Topographic drum sequencer port of the Mutable Instruments Grids eurorack module. Algorithmic three-channel rhythmic pattern generator using extracted drum-loop models, with drum-map and euclidean modes.

inputs.name: map_x
inputs.description: X coordinate of drum map, or sequence length in euclidean mode (0..1)

inputs.name: map_y
inputs.description: Y coordinate of drum map, or sequence length in euclidean mode (0..1)

inputs.name: chaos
inputs.description: Chaos amount, swing amount when swing is on, or sequence length in euclidean mode (0..1)

inputs.name: bd_dens
inputs.description: Channel 1 (bass drum) trigger density / euclidean fill rate (0..1)

inputs.name: sd_dens
inputs.description: Channel 2 (snare drum) trigger density / euclidean fill rate (0..1)

inputs.name: hh_dens
inputs.description: Channel 3 (hi-hat) trigger density / euclidean fill rate (0..1)

inputs.name: clock_trig
inputs.description: External clock trigger/gate input. Default expects 24 ppqn

inputs.name: swing
inputs.description: Swing on/off (0/1). Only effective in drum mode with internal clock

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Output config (0/1). 0=accents on outputs 4-6, 1=global accent + clock + reset on outputs 4-6

inputs.name: reso
inputs.description: Clock resolution (set at instantiation). 0=4 ppqn, 1=8 ppqn, 2=24 ppqn

name: MiMu
description: 8-bit mu-law companding extracted from the Mutable Instruments Clouds module. Adds gentle cassette-like degradation; soft-clips amplitudes outside +/-1.

inputs.name: gain
inputs.description: Gain applied to the input. Values driving past +/-1 add soft-clip distortion

name: MiOmi
description: FM synth voice with multimode filter, based on the 'ominous' 2x2-op FM easter egg from Mutable Instruments Elements. Skips oversampling and reverb of the original and adds a few extensions.

inputs.name: gate
inputs.description: Gate input. Non-positive to positive transition triggers amplitude and filter envelopes

inputs.name: contour
inputs.description: Envelope contour from AD to ADSR (0..1)

inputs.name: fb
inputs.description: Feedback modulation amount of both oscillators (0..1)

inputs.name: filter_mode
inputs.description: Multimode filter morph LP -> HP -> BP (0..1)

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: Offset for amplitude and filter envelopes (0..1)

inputs.name: env
inputs.description: Envelope amount applied to filter cutoff (0..1)
